newsitem.title: USA: Digital to launch low-end servers Monday.
newsitem.headline: Digital to launch low-end servers Monday.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp will launch on Monday two low-priced servers, which the company said will be priced "significantly" below similar competitors products.

The Digital Prioris XL 6000 series will be priced from $2,000 to $4,000 based on configuration. The Digital Prioris MX 6200 series will be priced from $3,000 to $5,000 based on configuration. Both are powered by the Intel Corp's Pentium Pro.

"We measure ourselves against Compaq (Computer Corp) since Compaq is the industry's number one provider in terms of unit provider," Marilyn Sadowski, group manager for worldwide product marketing for personal computer servers told Reuters.
She said Prioris MX is priced 25 percent to 35 percent below a similiar product offered by Compaq.
The new servers include the same features and options from its high-end Prioris servers for total enterprise solutions, Digital said.
